question: which customers are spending most and what are the products they are purchasing the most and what is the average proce of each of the product ....give me top 5 customers absed analysis
sql:
WITH customer_spend AS (
  SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
         c.name,
         SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  GROUP BY c.id, c.name
),
top_customers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM customer_spend
  ORDER BY total_spent DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
customer_product AS (
  SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
         p.id AS product_id,
         p.name AS product_name,
         SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity,
         SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS product_spent
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY c.id, p.id, p.name
),
ranked_product AS (
  SELECT cp.*,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.customer_id ORDER BY cp.total_quantity DESC) AS rn
  FROM customer_product cp
),
product_avg_price AS (
  SELECT product_id, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_unit_price
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT tc.customer_id,
       tc.name,
       tc.total_spent,
       rp.product_id,
       rp.product_name,
       rp.total_quantity,
       rp.product_spent,
       pap.avg_unit_price
FROM top_customers tc
JOIN ranked_product rp
  ON rp.customer_id = tc.customer_id
 AND rp.rn = 1
JOIN product_avg_price pap
  ON pap.product_id = rp.product_id
ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC;

question: give top 5 returned products along with their reasons
sql:
WITH product_returns AS (
  SELECT p.id,
         p.name,
         r.reason,
         COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
  FROM returns r
  JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name, r.reason
), ranked AS (
  SELECT pr.*,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pr.id ORDER BY pr.return_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM product_returns pr
)
SELECT name,
       reason,
       return_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY return_cnt DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: tell me the month on month growth for an year
sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date)::date AS month,
         SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', order_date)
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT month,
         total_sales,
         EXTRACT(year FROM month) AS yr
  FROM monthly
),
latest_year AS (
  SELECT MAX(yr) AS yr FROM yearly
)
SELECT y.month,
       y.total_sales,
       CASE
         WHEN LAG(y.total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY y.month) IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (y.total_sales - LAG(y.total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY y.month)) / LAG(y.total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY y.month), 2)
       END AS month_on_month_growth_percent
FROM yearly y
JOIN latest_year ly ON y.yr = ly.yr
ORDER BY y.month;
